rawOutput.title: Personal Finance Fundamentals
rawOutput.topic: Budgeting, credit, debt, and index-fund investing
rawOutput.rationale: This mixed conceptual and problem-solving plan begins with core cash-flow and interest concepts, then applies them to credit, debt, and index-fund investing. Practical examples and bounded tasks keep each session manageable. Guidance starts explicitly because most areas are new, then shifts to comparison, calculation, and integrated decision-making.

sessions.title: Build a Working Budget
sessions.objective: Construct a basic monthly budget and identify how cash flow supports later financial decisions.
sessions.amountLabel: One monthly cash-flow model with two decision checks
contentTargets: Income, fixed expenses, variable expenses, and savings
Monthly surplus, deficit, and emergency-fund priorities
completionEvidence: Classify sample transactions by budget category
Construct a balanced monthly budget from a sample income and expense list
Explain one adjustment that would resolve a budget deficit

sessions.title: Understand Interest and Borrowing Costs
sessions.objective: Explain how interest changes balances and calculate simple borrowing costs.
sessions.amountLabel: Simple and compound interest concepts with three calculations
contentTargets: Principal, interest rate, term, APR, and compounding
How payment size and time affect total borrowing cost
completionEvidence: Explain the roles of principal, APR, and term in a loan
Solve two basic interest-cost calculations
Compare the total cost of two borrowing offers

sessions.title: Use Credit Responsibly
sessions.objective: Connect credit behavior to credit reports, scores, and borrowing decisions.
sessions.amountLabel: Credit reports, scoring factors, and one card statement
contentTargets: Credit reports, credit scores, and major scoring factors
Credit-card statements, utilization, minimum payments, and grace periods
completionEvidence: Explain how payment history and utilization can affect credit
Classify credit-card actions as helpful, harmful, or context-dependent
Apply statement information to determine a payment and due date

sessions.title: Create a Debt Repayment Plan
sessions.objective: Prioritize debts while protecting essential expenses and minimum payments.
sessions.amountLabel: One debt inventory and repayment comparison
contentTargets: Debt inventory using balances, rates, and minimum payments
Highest-interest-first and smallest-balance-first repayment approaches
completionEvidence: Construct a debt inventory from a sample case
Compare two repayment orders using cost and motivation considerations
Draft a monthly repayment plan that covers every minimum payment

sessions.title: Learn Index-Fund Investing Basics
sessions.objective: Explain how diversified index funds work and distinguish investing from short-term saving.
sessions.amountLabel: Diversification, index funds, fees, risk, and account purpose
contentTargets: Stocks, bonds, diversification, risk, and time horizon
Index funds, expense ratios, and the difference between funds and account types
Why emergency savings and high-interest debt usually precede long-term investing
completionEvidence: Explain index-fund diversification in plain language
Compare two hypothetical funds using diversification and fees
Classify financial goals as better suited to cash savings or long-term investing
Construct a basic order of operations for saving, debt repayment, and investing

sessions.title: Integrate the Financial Plan
sessions.objective: Apply budgeting, credit, debt, and investing concepts to a realistic household case.
sessions.amountLabel: One integrated case with a prioritized action plan
contentTargets: Prioritizing cash flow, emergency savings, credit obligations, debt, and investing
Recognizing tradeoffs and missing information in personal-finance decisions
completionEvidence: Construct a prioritized financial action plan for a sample household
Explain how interest rates and time horizons support the chosen priorities
Apply the plan to one changed circumstance and revise the recommendation
